about_the_game:
The city’s gone lawless – gangs rule the streets, and the police can’t keep up.

Start from nothing and build your criminal empire in Ganglands, a co-op game where survival means outsmarting the system, rival gangs, and even your own limits.

Co-op gameplay (1–4 Players):

Team up with your friends in online co-op and run the streets together. Plan heists, defend turf, and grow your empire side by side.

Grow and Sell Weed:

Set up indoor grows, manage your weed production, and sell it on the streets or in bulk to shady dealers. The better your house, the more you can grow.

Rob Houses – Stealth or Smash:

Break into homes, pick locks, and sneak past residents. The better the neighborhood, the tighter the security—and the bigger the loot.

Loot & Trade System:

Fence stolen goods or trade them on the streets. Use pawn shops for quick cash, or strike better deals with black market contacts.

Rob Banks with Your Crew:

Plan high-stakes bank heists with your gang. Fight off rival crews, security guards, and police as you battle for the prize.

Expand Your Empire:

Hire gang members, buy cars, upgrade your safehouse, and unlock new neighborhoods with richer targets and tougher defenses.

Customize Your Character:

Style your look and gear to stand out—or blend in. Your reputation grows with your success.

Defend Your Turf:

Other gangs want what you’ve built. Set traps, arm your crew, and hold your ground when they come to take it.

Ganglands is about strategy, teamwork, risk—and reward. Will you rise to the top, or get buried in the streets?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: In a city ruled by gangs, power means everything. Rob banks, raid houses, recruit gangsters, and grow your empire. Defend your territory and become the dominant gang in town.
